title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 2 (Until after the fire danger class falls below DGR III)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2020, s. 9; am. B.C. Regs. 83/2022; 110/2023, s. 13.] Restrictions on High Risk Activities Item Column 1 Fire Danger Class (DGR) Column 2 Restriction Column 3
Until after the fire danger class falls below DGR III
2 IV (high) Maintain a fire watcher immediately after the high risk activity ends for a minimum of 2 hours
